T: Sail to the edge of the world. Pack lunch.
D: Lucy, Edmund and their cousin Eustace are pulled into Narnia aboard the Dawn Treader.
P: Serve the mains when the crew lays the seven swords on Aslan's table.
S: Crisp biscuits of oats, flour and vintage cheddar

Homemade oat and cheddar biscuits baked crisp like ship's rations, topped with sharp cheddar, tomato chutney and a slice of pickle. Rub 80g cold butter into 100g plain flour and 100g rolled oats with a pinch of salt. Stir in 80g grated vintage cheddar and 3 tbsp cold milk to form a dough. Roll 5mm thick, cut into 16 squares and prick with a fork. Bake at 180C for 15 minutes until golden, then cool. Top each with a slice of cheddar from 150g, a spoon of tomato chutney and a slice of dill pickle.
Green and kalamata olives warmed in olive oil with lemon peel, garlic and chilli
Green and black olives warmed in olive oil with lemon peel, garlic and chilli, served with torn crusty bread.

Button mushrooms stuffed with garlic butter, breadcrumbs and parmesan, baked at 200C for 12 minutes. Remove the stalks from 20 large button mushrooms and chop the stalks finely. Mix 80g soft butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves, the chopped stalks, chopped parsley and salt. Fill the mushroom caps with the butter. Mix 40g breadcrumbs with 30g grated parmesan and press on top. Bake on a tray at 200C for 12 minutes until bubbling and golden. Serve hot with toothpicks.
M: Aslan's table roast chicken and grapes
Enough for all at Aslan's table

Roast chicken with lemon and herbs, roast potatoes, grapes roasted on the vine, and crusty bread laid out on a long table. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 40g soft butter, lemon zest, thyme and salt and stuff with the halved lemon. Roast at 200C for 75 minutes. Parboil 1kg potatoes in chunks, rough them up and roast in oil for 50 minutes. Add 4 small bunches of red grapes on the vine to the chicken tray for the last 15 minutes until they blister. Rest the chicken 10 minutes and lay everything out on a board with torn crusty bread.
Crisp skin snapper in lemon caper butter, lightly crushed baby potatoes
Snapper fillets pan-fried skin side down until crisp, finished with lemon butter and capers, with crushed baby potatoes.
W: Meringue topped with whipped cream and thin slices of white peach
Meringue baked at 120C for 90 minutes and cooled in the oven, topped with whipped cream and sliced white peaches.
K: Lemon juice and elderflower cordial with cucumber ribbons and mint

Fresh lemon juice and elderflower cordial stirred with cold water and torn mint, poured over ice with cucumber ribbons. Mix the juice of 4 lemons with 100ml elderflower cordial and 700ml cold water in a jug. Peel 1 Lebanese cucumber into long ribbons. Tear a handful of mint into the jug and stir. Fill 4 glasses with ice and cucumber ribbons and pour the lemonade over. Top with a splash of soda water if you want bubbles.
